package.name: school_traffic_control
package.description: Decision-making node for school traffic control. Consumes vehicle and pedestrian detections (traffic_perception_msgs) and a plate-allowed bool, and drives the robot base (base_navigation GoToXYPhi action) and arm gestures (play_motion2 PlayMotion2 action) to hold, stop, and wave vehicles through a crossing. Pedestrians only trigger a spoken warning via the communication_skills Say action and never affect motion.
